```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

rm(list = ls())

source(here::here("R", "config.R"))
source(here::here("R", "helpers.R"))
source(here::here("R", "firestore_api.R"))
fn_setup()

# Fixed timestamp for the entire run — ensures hold-period logic is deterministic
# within a single execution (no drift from Sys.time() called at different points)
RUN_TIMESTAMP <- Sys.time()
# Blues uses its own sheet — no connection to Lindy/Solo
BLUES_SHEET <- GOOGLE_SHEETS$registrations_2026_blues
cat("Run timestamp:", format(RUN_TIMESTAMP, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), "\n")
```

## Load Registrations from Firebase

```{r}
#| label: load-data

df_raw <- fn_get_registrations(filters = list(pass = "blues_workshop"))
write_sheet(df_raw, ss = BLUES_SHEET, "raw_data_blues")
```

## Load Previous State (for idempotency & state-diff)

```{r}
#| label: load-previous-state

# Try to read the previous final_tally from Google Sheets.
# This is the source of truth for who was already CONFIRMED / WAITLIST / ON_HOLD.
# If it doesn't exist yet (first run), we start with an empty frame.
prev_tally <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(BLUES_SHEET, sheet = "blues_final_tally"),
  error = function(e) {
    message("No previous blues_final_tally found — first run.")
    tibble(
      email         = character(),
      prev_status   = character(),
      prev_blues_in = logical()
    )
  }
)

# Keep only the columns we need for comparison
if (nrow(prev_tally) > 0 && "status" %in% names(prev_tally)) {
  prev_tally <- prev_tally |>
    select(
      email,
      prev_status   = status,
      prev_blues_in = any_of("blues_in")
    ) |>
    mutate(
      prev_blues_in = coalesce(as.logical(prev_blues_in), FALSE),
      prev_status = coalesce(prev_status, "UNKNOWN")
    )
} else {
  prev_tally <- tibble(
    email         = character(),
    prev_status   = character(),
    prev_blues_in = logical()
  )
}

cat("Previous tally rows:", nrow(prev_tally), "\n")
```

## Clean and Prepare Data

```{r}
#| label: clean-data

# Firebase schema columns:
# name, email, pass, role, partner_email, level, created_at,
# payment_status, amount_cents, id, stripe_* fields

df_clean <- df_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(email) & email != "") |>
  filter(pass == "blues_workshop") |>
  mutate(
    created_at = as.POSIXct(created_at),
    name = str_to_title(name),
    email = str_to_lower(email),
    partner_email = str_to_lower(coalesce(partner_email, "")),
    level = str_to_lower(level),
    # Standardize partner field (guard against partner_email == own email)
    partner_email = if_else(partner_email == email, "", partner_email),
    has_partner = partner_email != "" & !is.na(partner_email)
  ) |>
  arrange(created_at) |>
  # Deduplicate: keep the latest registration per email
  # (handles re-submissions; latest row has the most up-to-date preferences)
  group_by(email) |>
  slice_max(created_at, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-c(stripe_payment_method_id)) |>
  relocate(created_at, id, email, name, pass, role, level, has_partner, partner_email) |>
  arrange(created_at)

# Report duplicates removed
n_before_dedup <- df_raw |> filter(!is.na(email) & email != "", pass == "blues_workshop") |> nrow()
cat("Registrations before dedup:", n_before_dedup,
    "| after dedup:", nrow(df_clean),
    "| removed:", n_before_dedup - nrow(df_clean), "duplicates\n")

# Show pass distribution
df_clean |> count(role, level) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = role, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

write_sheet(df_clean, ss = BLUES_SHEET, "blues_clean_data")
```

## Define Quotas

```{r}
#| label: quotas

# Quotas derived from the single source of truth in config.R
# - quota = number of pair slots = leader capacity per level
# - overflow_followers = extra confirmed-follower spots above the pair quota
BLUES_QUOTAS <- tibble(
  level = "intermediate_plus",
  quota = GROUP_CAPACITIES$blues_intermediate_plus,
  overflow_followers = OVERFLOW_FOLLOWERS$blues_intermediate_plus
)

# Hold period: days to wait for a listed partner to register before treating as single
PARTNER_HOLD_DAYS <- 3

cat("Blues quotas:\n")
print(BLUES_QUOTAS)
cat("Hold period:", PARTNER_HOLD_DAYS, "days\n")
```

## Helper Functions for Matching

```{r}
#| label: helper-functions

#' Match leaders and followers for a dance track
#'
#' @param df Data frame with registrations for a specific track
#' @param quota_df Data frame with `level` and `quota` columns, plus optional
#'   `overflow_followers` (extra confirmed-follower slots above the pair quota).
#'   If `overflow_followers` is missing it defaults to 0 for every level.
#'   A single number can also be passed (applies the same quota to every level
#'   with overflow = 0).
#' @param hold_days Number of days to hold a spot for an unmatched partner before
#'   treating the registrant as a single. 0 = no hold (immediate single matching).
#' @param run_ts Fixed timestamp for this run (avoids Sys.time() drift)
#' @param prev_pairs Optional tibble of ALL pairs from the previous run.
#'   Complete eligible pairs are locked as units. Incomplete eligible rows
#'   (e.g. an overflow follower paired with NA leader) keep their lone member
#'   in the matching pool with a `was_locked` flag so they get priority and
#'   can be re-paired with newly registered counterparts while preserving
#'   their CONFIRMED status.
#' @return List with `pairs` (matched pairs with per-role eligibility and a
#'   pair-level `eligible` flag) and `on_hold` (registrants still waiting for
#'   their partner within the hold period)
fn_match_partners <- function(df, quota_df, hold_days = 0,
                              run_ts = RUN_TIMESTAMP,
                              prev_pairs = NULL) {

  if (!is.data.frame(quota_df)) {
    quota_df <- tibble(
      level = unique(df$level),
      quota = quota_df,
      overflow_followers = 0L
    )
  } else if (!"overflow_followers" %in% names(quota_df)) {
    quota_df <- quota_df |> mutate(overflow_followers = 0L)
  }

  leaders <- df |>
    filter(role == "leader") |>
    select(created_at, email, level, has_partner, partner_email) |>
    mutate(was_locked = FALSE)

  followers <- df |>
    filter(role == "follower") |>
    select(created_at, email, level, has_partner, partner_email) |>
    mutate(was_locked = FALSE)

  # ── Step 0: Categorise previously eligible pairs ──
  if (!is.null(prev_pairs) && nrow(prev_pairs) > 0) {
    eligible_prev <- prev_pairs |> filter(eligible)

    locked_pairs <- eligible_prev |>
      filter(!is.na(email_leader), !is.na(email_follower))

    lone_locked_leaders <- eligible_prev |>
      filter(!is.na(email_leader),  is.na(email_follower)) |>
      pull(email_leader) |>
      unique()

    lone_locked_followers <- eligible_prev |>
      filter( is.na(email_leader), !is.na(email_follower)) |>
      pull(email_follower) |>
      unique()

    locked_emails_complete <- c(
      locked_pairs$email_leader,
      locked_pairs$email_follower
    )

    leaders   <- leaders   |> filter(!email %in% locked_emails_complete)
    followers <- followers |> filter(!email %in% locked_emails_complete)

    leaders <- leaders |>
      mutate(was_locked = email %in% lone_locked_leaders)
    followers <- followers |>
      mutate(was_locked = email %in% lone_locked_followers)

    cat("  Locked", nrow(locked_pairs), "complete pairs (",
        sum(locked_pairs$is_couple), "couples,",
        sum(!locked_pairs$is_couple), "singles pairs ) +",
        length(lone_locked_leaders), "lone leaders,",
        length(lone_locked_followers), "lone followers (e.g. overflow)\n")
  } else {
    locked_pairs           <- NULL
    lone_locked_leaders    <- character()
    lone_locked_followers  <- character()
  }

  # ── Step 1: Match registered couples (mutual partner reference + same level) ──
  couples <- leaders |>
    filter(has_partner) |>
    inner_join(
      followers |> filter(has_partner),
      by = c("partner_email" = "email", "level" = "level"),
      suffix = c("_leader", "_follower")
    ) |>
    filter(email == partner_email_follower) |>
    mutate(was_locked = was_locked_leader | was_locked_follower) |>
    select(
      email_leader = email,
      email_follower = partner_email,
      level,
      created_at_leader,
      created_at_follower,
      was_locked
    ) |>
    mutate(is_couple = TRUE)

  # ── Step 2: Unmatched partners ──
  unmatched_leaders <- leaders |>
    filter(has_partner) |>
    anti_join(couples, by = c("email" = "email_leader"))

  unmatched_followers <- followers |>
    filter(has_partner) |>
    anti_join(couples, by = c("email" = "email_follower"))

  # ── Step 2b: Hold period ──
  if (hold_days > 0) {
    hold_cutoff <- run_ts - as.difftime(hold_days, units = "days")

    on_hold_leaders   <- unmatched_leaders  |> filter(created_at > hold_cutoff)
    expired_leaders   <- unmatched_leaders  |> filter(created_at <= hold_cutoff)
    on_hold_followers <- unmatched_followers |> filter(created_at > hold_cutoff)
    expired_followers <- unmatched_followers |> filter(created_at <= hold_cutoff)

    on_hold <- bind_rows(
      on_hold_leaders   |> mutate(role = "leader"),
      on_hold_followers |> mutate(role = "follower")
    )
  } else {
    expired_leaders   <- unmatched_leaders
    expired_followers <- unmatched_followers
    on_hold <- tibble(
      created_at    = as.POSIXct(character()),
      email         = character(),
      level         = character(),
      has_partner   = logical(),
      partner_email = character(),
      role          = character()
    )
  }

  # ── Step 3: Build singles pool ──
  single_leaders <- leaders |>
    filter(!has_partner) |>
    bind_rows(expired_leaders |> select(-partner_email)) |>
    arrange(created_at)

  single_followers <- followers |>
    filter(!has_partner) |>
    bind_rows(expired_followers |> select(-partner_email)) |>
    arrange(created_at)

  # ── Step 3b: Match new singles by index within each level ──
  # was_locked individuals sort first so they get re-paired with priority.
  single_leaders <- single_leaders |>
    group_by(level) |>
    arrange(desc(was_locked), created_at, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(idx = row_number()) |>
    ungroup()
  single_followers <- single_followers |>
    group_by(level) |>
    arrange(desc(was_locked), created_at, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(idx = row_number()) |>
    ungroup()

  non_couples <- single_leaders |>
    full_join(single_followers, by = c("idx", "level"), suffix = c("_leader", "_follower")) |>
    mutate(
      was_locked = coalesce(was_locked_leader, FALSE) |
                   coalesce(was_locked_follower, FALSE)
    ) |>
    select(email_leader, email_follower, level,
           created_at_leader, created_at_follower, was_locked) |>
    mutate(is_couple = FALSE)

  # ── Step 4: Combine new couples + new singles ──
  new_pairs <- bind_rows(couples, non_couples) |>
    mutate(
      created_at_pair = pmax(created_at_leader, created_at_follower, na.rm = TRUE),
      is_locked = FALSE,
      was_locked = coalesce(was_locked, FALSE)
    )

  # ── Step 5: Combine locked + new ──
  if (!is.null(locked_pairs) && nrow(locked_pairs) > 0) {
    locked_for_combine <- locked_pairs |>
      mutate(
        created_at_pair = pmax(created_at_leader, created_at_follower, na.rm = TRUE),
        is_locked  = TRUE,
        was_locked = TRUE
      ) |>
      select(email_leader, email_follower, level,
             created_at_leader, created_at_follower,
             is_couple, created_at_pair, is_locked, was_locked)

    all_pairs <- bind_rows(locked_for_combine, new_pairs)
  } else {
    all_pairs <- new_pairs
  }

  # Number pairs: locked first, then was_locked re-pairings, then new ones
  all_pairs <- all_pairs |>
    group_by(level) |>
    arrange(!is_locked,
            !was_locked,
            is.na(email_leader) | is.na(email_follower),
            created_at_pair,
            .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(pair_number = row_number()) |>
    ungroup()

  # ── Step 6: Per-role rank → eligibility (allows overflow followers) ──
  # follower_cap = min(eligible_leaders + overflow_followers,
  #                    quota            + overflow_followers)
  all_pairs <- all_pairs |>
    left_join(quota_df, by = "level") |>
    group_by(level) |>
    arrange(pair_number, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
      leader_rank   = if_else(!is.na(email_leader),
                              cumsum(!is.na(email_leader)),
                              NA_integer_),
      follower_rank = if_else(!is.na(email_follower),
                              cumsum(!is.na(email_follower)),
                              NA_integer_),
      leader_eligible = !is.na(email_leader) & leader_rank <= quota,
      eligible_leaders_in_level = sum(coalesce(leader_eligible, FALSE)),
      follower_cap = pmin(eligible_leaders_in_level + coalesce(overflow_followers, 0L),
                          quota + coalesce(overflow_followers, 0L))
    ) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
      follower_eligible = !is.na(email_follower) & follower_rank <= follower_cap,
      eligible          = coalesce(leader_eligible, FALSE) |
                          coalesce(follower_eligible, FALSE)
    ) |>
    select(-eligible_leaders_in_level, -follower_cap)

  list(pairs = all_pairs, on_hold = on_hold)
}

#' Convert paired data to individual eligibility (per-role aware)
#'
#' @param pairs_df Data frame with matched pairs (must contain leader_eligible
#'   and follower_eligible)
#' @param track_name Name of the track (for column naming)
#' @return Data frame with email and eligibility status
fn_pairs_to_individual <- function(pairs_df, track_name) {
  col_name <- paste0(track_name, "_in")

  leaders <- pairs_df |>
    filter(!is.na(email_leader)) |>
    transmute(email = email_leader, is_in = coalesce(leader_eligible, FALSE))

  followers <- pairs_df |>
    filter(!is.na(email_follower)) |>
    transmute(email = email_follower, is_in = coalesce(follower_eligible, FALSE))

  bind_rows(leaders, followers) |>
    group_by(email) |>
    summarise(!!col_name := any(is_in), .groups = "drop")
}
```

## Process Blues Registrations

```{r}
#| label: blues-processing

df_blues <- df_clean |>
  select(created_at, email, role, level, has_partner, partner_email)

# Load ALL previous pairs from Google Sheets (if they exist).
prev_blues_pairs <- tryCatch(
  read_sheet(BLUES_SHEET, sheet = "blues_pairs_locked"),
  error = function(e) {
    message("No previous blues_pairs_locked sheet — first run.")
    NULL
  }
)

# Match partners for Blues (passing previous pairs for stability)
blues_result <- fn_match_partners(
  df_blues,
  quota_df  = BLUES_QUOTAS,
  hold_days = PARTNER_HOLD_DAYS,
  run_ts    = RUN_TIMESTAMP,
  prev_pairs = prev_blues_pairs
)
blues_pairs   <- blues_result$pairs
blues_on_hold <- blues_result$on_hold

# Summary by level
blues_summary <- blues_pairs |>
  group_by(level) |>
  summarise(
    complete_pairs       = sum(!is.na(email_leader) & !is.na(email_follower)),
    confirmed_leaders    = sum(coalesce(leader_eligible,   FALSE)),
    confirmed_followers  = sum(coalesce(follower_eligible, FALSE)),
    quota                = first(quota),
    overflow_followers   = first(overflow_followers),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(blues_summary)

# Get individual eligibility
blues_eligible <- fn_pairs_to_individual(blues_pairs, "blues")

# ── Monotonic safety net: never demote a previously confirmed blues participant ──
if (nrow(prev_tally) > 0) {
  blues_before <- blues_eligible
  blues_eligible <- blues_eligible |>
    left_join(prev_tally |> select(email, prev_blues_in), by = "email") |>
    mutate(blues_in = coalesce(blues_in, FALSE) | coalesce(prev_blues_in, FALSE)) |>
    select(email, blues_in)

  n_saved <- sum(blues_eligible$blues_in & !coalesce(blues_before$blues_in, FALSE))
  if (n_saved > 0) {
    cat("  ⚠ Monotonic safety net saved", n_saved, "blues participants from demotion\n")
  }
}

# Persist locked-in pairs for next run
write_sheet(blues_pairs, ss = BLUES_SHEET, sheet = "blues_pairs_locked")
```

## Final Tally - Combine All Results

```{r}
#| label: final-tally

# Create on-hold indicator from blues processing
blues_on_hold_emails <- if (nrow(blues_on_hold) > 0) {
  blues_on_hold |> distinct(email) |> mutate(is_on_hold = TRUE)
} else {
  tibble(email = character(), is_on_hold = logical())
}

# Combine all eligibility results (Blues only — no Solo Jazz)
final_tally <- df_clean |>
  select(
    id, created_at, email, name, pass, role, level,
    has_partner, partner_email,
    payment_status, amount_cents
  ) |>
  left_join(blues_eligible, by = "email") |>
  left_join(blues_on_hold_emails, by = "email") |>
  mutate(
    # Determine overall status (Blues only)
    status = case_when(
      coalesce(is_on_hold, FALSE) ~ "ON_HOLD",
      coalesce(blues_in, FALSE) ~ "CONFIRMED",
      TRUE ~ "WAITLIST"
    )
  )

# Sanity check
dup_emails <- final_tally |> count(email) |> filter(n > 1)
if (nrow(dup_emails) > 0) {
  warning("DUPLICATE EMAILS in final_tally: ", paste(dup_emails$email, collapse = ", "))
}
stopifnot("final_tally has duplicate emails!" = nrow(dup_emails) == 0)

# Status summary
status_summary <- final_tally |>
  count(status) |>
  arrange(desc(n))

cat("\n=== FINAL STATUS SUMMARY ===\n")
print(status_summary)

cat("\n=== DETAILED BREAKDOWN ===\n")
final_tally |>
  group_by(status) |>
  summarise(
    count = n(),
    blues_in = sum(blues_in, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  print()
```

## State Diff — Previous vs New

```{r}
#| label: state-diff

if (nrow(prev_tally) > 0) {
  state_diff <- final_tally |>
    select(email, name, role, level, status, blues_in) |>
    left_join(prev_tally, by = "email", suffix = c("", "_prev")) |>
    mutate(
      prev_status  = coalesce(prev_status, "NEW"),
      status_changed = status != prev_status,
      transition = if_else(
        status_changed,
        paste0(prev_status, " -> ", status),
        "no change"
      )
    )

  promotions <- state_diff |>
    filter(
      status_changed,
      prev_status %in% c("WAITLIST", "ON_HOLD", "NEW"),
      status == "CONFIRMED"
    ) |>
    select(name, email, role, level, transition)

  cat("\n=== PROMOTIONS (need confirmation email) ===\n")
  if (nrow(promotions) > 0) {
    print(promotions, n = 100)
  } else {
    cat("No promotions since last run.\n")
  }

  demotions <- state_diff |>
    filter(
      status_changed,
      prev_status == "CONFIRMED",
      status %in% c("WAITLIST", "ON_HOLD")
    ) |>
    select(name, email, role, level, transition)

  if (nrow(demotions) > 0) {
    cat("\n⚠ WARNING: DEMOTIONS DETECTED (should not happen!) ===\n")
    print(demotions, n = 100)
  }

  new_regs <- state_diff |>
    filter(prev_status == "NEW") |>
    select(name, email, role, level, status)

  cat("\n=== NEW REGISTRATIONS SINCE LAST RUN ===\n")
  if (nrow(new_regs) > 0) {
    print(new_regs, n = 100)
  } else {
    cat("No new registrations.\n")
  }

  cat("\n=== TRANSITION SUMMARY ===\n")
  state_diff |>
    count(transition) |>
    arrange(desc(n)) |>
    print()

} else {
  cat("First run — no previous state to compare against.\n")
}
```

## Write Blues Levels to Google Sheets

```{r}
#| label: write-levels-to-sheets

blues_pairs_display <- blues_pairs |>
  left_join(df_clean |> select(email, name, payment_status), by = c("email_leader" = "email")) |>
  rename(leader_name = name, payment_status_leader = payment_status) |>
  left_join(df_clean |> select(email, name, payment_status), by = c("email_follower" = "email")) |>
  rename(follower_name = name, payment_status_follower = payment_status) |>
  mutate(
    leader_paid = coalesce(str_to_lower(payment_status_leader) == "captured" | str_detect(str_to_lower(payment_status_leader), "paid"), FALSE),
    follower_paid = coalesce(str_to_lower(payment_status_follower) == "captured" | str_detect(str_to_lower(payment_status_follower), "paid"), FALSE)
  ) |>
  select(level, pair_number,
         leader_name, leader_email = email_leader, leader_paid,
         leader_eligible, created_at_leader,
         follower_name, follower_email = email_follower, follower_paid,
         follower_eligible, created_at_follower,
         is_couple, eligible) |>
  arrange(level, pair_number)

levels_to_write <- list(
  "Blues Intermediate+" = "intermediate_plus"
)

for (sheet_name in names(levels_to_write)) {
  lvl <- levels_to_write[[sheet_name]]
  lvl_pairs <- blues_pairs |> filter(level == lvl)
  lvl_data  <- blues_pairs_display |> filter(level == lvl) |> select(-level)

  quota_val    <- BLUES_QUOTAS |> filter(level == lvl) |> pull(quota)
  overflow_val <- BLUES_QUOTAS |> filter(level == lvl) |> pull(overflow_followers)

  complete             <- sum(!is.na(lvl_data$leader_email) & !is.na(lvl_data$follower_email))
  confirmed_leaders    <- sum(coalesce(lvl_pairs$leader_eligible,   FALSE))
  confirmed_followers  <- sum(coalesce(lvl_pairs$follower_eligible, FALSE))
  overflow_followers_active <- max(0L, confirmed_followers - confirmed_leaders)
  leader_spots_left    <- max(0L, quota_val - confirmed_leaders)
  follower_spots_left  <- max(0L, (quota_val + overflow_val) - confirmed_followers)

  summary_df <- tibble(
    Metric = c(
      "Pair quota", "Follower overflow",
      "Complete pairs",
      "Confirmed leaders", "Confirmed followers",
      "Overflow followers (currently)",
      "Leader spots left", "Follower spots left"
    ),
    Value = c(
      quota_val, overflow_val,
      complete,
      confirmed_leaders, confirmed_followers,
      overflow_followers_active,
      leader_spots_left, follower_spots_left
    )
  )

  write_sheet(summary_df, ss = BLUES_SHEET, sheet = sheet_name)
  range_write(lvl_data, ss = BLUES_SHEET, sheet = sheet_name,
              range = paste0("A", nrow(summary_df) + 3))

  cat("Written sheet:", sheet_name, "—", complete, "complete pairs,",
      leader_spots_left, "leader spots left,",
      follower_spots_left, "follower spots left\n")
}
```

## Waitlist Details

```{r}
#| label: waitlist-details

waitlist <- final_tally |>
  filter(status == "WAITLIST") |>
  mutate(waitlist_for = "Blues") |>
  select(name, email, status, waitlist_for, level, role, has_partner, partner_email)

on_hold <- final_tally |>
  filter(status == "ON_HOLD") |>
  select(name, email, level, role, partner_email, created_at) |>
  mutate(
    hold_expires = created_at + as.difftime(PARTNER_HOLD_DAYS, units = "days")
  )

cat("\n=== ON HOLD (partner has", PARTNER_HOLD_DAYS, "days to register) ===\n")
if (nrow(on_hold) > 0) {
  print(on_hold, n = 50)
} else {
  cat("No registrations currently on hold.\n")
}

cat("\n=== WAITLIST DETAILS ===\n")
print(waitlist, n = 50)
```

## Persist Final Tally

```{r}
#| label: persist-final-tally

write_sheet(final_tally, ss = BLUES_SHEET, sheet = "blues_final_tally")
cat("Final tally written to Google Sheets (", nrow(final_tally), "rows)\n")
cat("Run completed at:", format(RUN_TIMESTAMP, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z"), "\n")
```

## Update Firebase with Results (Optional)

```{r}
#| label: update-firebase
#| eval: false

changed <- final_tally |>
  select(id, email, status, blues_in) |>
  left_join(prev_tally, by = "email") |>
  mutate(
    prev_status   = coalesce(prev_status, "NEW"),
    prev_blues_in = coalesce(prev_blues_in, FALSE),
    cur_blues_in  = coalesce(blues_in, FALSE)
  ) |>
  filter(
    status       != prev_status |
    cur_blues_in != prev_blues_in
  )

cat("Registrations to update:", nrow(changed), "of", nrow(final_tally), "total\n\n")

if (nrow(changed) == 0) {
  cat("Nothing to update — Firebase is already in sync.\n")
} else {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(changed))) {
    reg <- changed[i, ]

    fn_update_registration(
      doc_id = reg$id,
      fields = list(
        blues_in = reg$cur_blues_in,
        status   = reg$status
      )
    )

    cat("Updated:", reg$email, "—", reg$prev_status, "->", reg$status,
        " | blues_in:", reg$cur_blues_in, "\n")
    Sys.sleep(0.5)
  }

  cat("\nFirebase update complete!", nrow(changed), "registrations updated.\n")
}
```
